---
title: "FACS QC report"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
params:
  prep: ""
  exclusions: NULL
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
prep <- readRDS(params$prep)
info <- prep$info
data <- prep$data
matched <- JanisHelpers::facs_match_exclusions(data, params$exclusions, info$assay)
clashes <- JanisHelpers::facs_check_file_clashes(data)
```

| | |
|---|---|
| Workspace | `r basename(info$wsp_path)` |
| Root / version | `r info$wsp_root` / `r format(info$wsp_version)` |
| Panel (assay) | `r info$assay` |
| Prep result created | `r format(info$created_at, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")` |
| JanisHelpers | `r info$package_version` |

All samples are shown. Rows on the exclusions sheet are only flagged here;
they are dropped at the final export.

## Files

```{r files}
files <- data |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_populations = dplyr::n_distinct(population_full_path),
    .by = c(file_name, mouse_ID, tissue, condition)
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    dplyr::rename(matched$excluded_files, excluded = reason),
    by = "file_name"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(excluded = dplyr::coalesce(excluded, "")) |>
  dplyr::arrange(mouse_ID, tissue, condition)
knitr::kable(files)
```

## Keyword clashes

```{r clashes, results = "asis"}
if (nrow(clashes) == 0) {
  cat("None -- every mouse_ID x tissue x condition comes from one file.\n")
} else {
  cat("**Warning: these files share one mouse_ID x tissue x condition.**",
      "Fix the keywords in FlowJo; the final export refuses until then.\n\n")
  print(knitr::kable(clashes))
}
```

## Exclusions

```{r exclusions, results = "asis"}
if (nrow(matched$applicable) == 0) {
  cat("No exclusions apply to this panel.\n")
} else {
  print(knitr::kable(matched$applicable))
}
if (nrow(matched$unmatched) > 0) {
  cat("\n\n### Warning: these rows match no file\n\n",
      "Check for typos -- the final export stops on them.\n\n")
  print(knitr::kable(matched$unmatched))
}
```
